name: Avenue Dental
headline:
Feel heard.
Then make a plan.
intro: A modern first-visit path with clear information about services, the team and what to ask before scheduling.
about_body: Avenue Dental is a fictional dental practice. This alternate direction uses a patient-led consultation, an office tour and a cautious first-visit form.
tagline: A clearer conversation about your care.
split_title: Know what to expect before arrival.
split_body: An actual licensed dentist reviews history, assessment and suitable options. Medical details belong in an approved private intake system; this public demonstration collects only example visit preferences.
services: Ask what the initial visit includes, how long it takes and whether records are needed. Actual examination and recommendations are clinician-led.
Confirm fees and insurance directly with the practice.
A licensed clinician recommends services for an individual after an assessment. This demo makes no clinical promises.
A real dentist explains findings, alternatives, risks, cost and consent before treatment. No diagnosis is offered here.
steps: Choose the general reason and example preference.
A real practice checks suitability, time and fees.
Health history is collected through an approved private process.
faqs: Should I enter symptoms or medical history here?
No. This public demo requests no clinical details.
Is a date a confirmed appointment?
No. Example dates check no live availability.
No invented credentials or patient reviews appear. The actual practice provides verified details before launch.
gallery_title: A welcoming practice, room by room.
note: Use example contact details only. Do not enter symptoms, medical records or insurance identifiers.
tool_title: See the first visit at a glance.
tool_intro: Choose a general visit preference and an example date. No appointment or clinical intake occurs.
proof: Add verified provider profiles and credentials.
